teaser: How one afternoon took the launch plan from a £50 site on Kickstarter to a configured Android tablet, a supporter tier and a Raspberry Pi.
core_idea: Eleven turns in one afternoon, each from a question, moved the launch plan from a service on Kickstarter, which its rules resist, through Indiegogo, Patreon and countries as stretch goals, to a hardware appliance on Android that fits Kickstarter, with what held throughout: one campaign, value first, the UK first, open source.

quotes.text: For the first time, I have a platform I can just give somebody: a website.
So a stretch goal cannot be a language. It is a place
